## MGIT Teams Selected for the Grand Finale of Smart India Hackathon (SIH) 2025

MGIT is proud to announce that two student teams —Team TECH MAXandTeam DARSHAN GO— have been selected for the prestigiousSmart India Hackathon (SIH) 2025 Grand Finale, marking a significant achievement for the institute.

## Team TECH MAX – Selected for SIH 2025 Grand Finale (Chennai, Tamil Nadu)

Team TECH MAX (Team ID: 65578)from MGIT has secured a place in the Grand Finale under theMiscellaneous theme – Software Category.The team qualified with the problem statement:

## “Development of a mobile application for secure water level data collection from rivers using image processing” (SIH25248)

Team Members:
- RAMAVATH VARUN(24261A1455)
- MANASVI GUDEY(24261A1434)
- RISHANTH PATKAR(25261A05Q2)
- YALAMANDALA SREE KARTIKEYA(24261A0159)
- Vishnu Ganesh Mukkavilli(25261A1459)
- MIRIYALA DIVYA TEJASWI(24261A0436)
The Grand Finale for their category will be held inChennai, Tamil Nadu, onDecember 8–9, 2025.

## Team DARSHAN GO – Selected for SIH 2025 Grand Finale (Noida, New Delhi)

Team DARSHAN GOfrom MGIT has also been selected as a finalist under theSmart Automation theme – Software Category.The team qualified with the problem statement:

## “Mapping of Implementing and Executing Agencies across PM-AJAY Components” (SIH 25153)

Team Members (CSE Department):
- Elukurthi Srujana(23261A05D8)
- P. Anil Kumar(23261A0542)
- B. Sujay Bhavani(23261A0557)
- V. Sai Vishwanath(23261A0560)
- Syed Jaffer(24265A0507)
- P. Aishwarya Reddy(23261A04H1)
The Grand Finale for their category is scheduled atNoida, New Delhi, onDecember 8–9, 2025.
MGIT congratulates both teams for their exceptional performance and wishes them great success in theSIH 2025 Grand Finale. Their selection reflects the institute’s excellence in innovation, problem-solving, and interdisciplinary collaboration.
